title: Unnamed settlement near Timechtaouine, Algeria
description: Remains of an ancient settlement of Roman date, recorded by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas). The location should lie within 2 km of the BAtlas coordinates: a point in the immediate vicinity of modern Timechtaouine (Draa Kebila municipal territory, Setif province, Algeria).

properties.description: Coordinates extracted using QGIS from a raster image of Barrington Atlas Map 31 that was georegistered to OpenStreetMap using prominent, stable landscape features. Dates after BAltDir.
